## About
St. Francis Veterinary Clinic was opened by Dr. Cristina Jaramillo and her family to serve the growing west side of Fort Worth and the communities near the Chisholm Trail corridor. Dr. Jaramillo earned her Doctorate of Veterinary Medicine at Western University of Health Sciences and worked at an emergency clinic and a general practice in the Fort Worth area before opening her own.
Her husband and co-owner, Mario Valdez, is an architect who helped design the clinic with one goal in mind: a place that feels like home. You are welcome to take a tour, or just relax in our comfortable waiting area while you wait.
We focus on looking at each pet as an individual, with an eye on prevention, early detection and good everyday care. We hold a 4.7 rating from 125 Google reviews.

## Services
- Pet wellness exams: Regular checkups focused on prevention and early detection.
- Vaccinations and vaccine titers: Vaccines to keep your pet protected, with titers available.
- Diagnostics: In-house x-rays, ultrasound and blood work to help find problems early.
- Dental services: Dental care as part of your pet's overall health.
- Spay and neutering: Spay and neuter surgery for dogs and cats.
- Surgical procedures: Surgery performed at the clinic.
- Limited hospitalization for sick pets: A place for sick pets to stay and recover under our care.
- Exotic medicine: Veterinary care for exotic pets.
- Daycare and medical boarding: A safe place for your pet while your family is away on vacation.
- Boarding & basic grooming: Boarding stays with basic grooming available.
- Pet pharmacy: Medications available right at the clinic.
- Parasite control: Help keeping fleas, ticks and other parasites away.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We close for lunch from 12:00 PM to 1:00 PM, and we are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What should I do in an emergency?
A: Contact your closest emergency clinic, or call us during our regular business hours.

Q: Can I text the clinic?
A: Yes. You can call, text or email us, whichever is easier for you, during our business hours.
